items.note: Casual short form of buenas tardes / buenas noches; works at any time of day, even in the morning.
Used from midday until dark, so it also covers the early evening. After dark, say Buenas noches.
Also the greeting after dark (Good evening).
Chao (or chau) is a very common casual alternative.
Often just means "bye", even if you will not see the person again today.
¿Qué tal? is just as common and even more casual. Polite: ¿Cómo está?
Polite: ¿Y usted?
Polite: ¿Cómo se llama?
Encantado is just as common; a woman says Encantada.
To a woman: ¡Bienvenida! To a group: ¡Bienvenidos!
Polite (usted) form; with friends say Disculpa. To get past someone, say Con permiso.
For a quick "sorry", e.g. when you bump into someone, say Perdón.
In reply to an apology, No pasa nada (It's nothing) is very common.
Por supuesto is a slightly more formal alternative.
